title: Review pages
text: Pages where this element tells, as the author of a review, how a deal with a partner went.

items.title: Anyone reads the element's review pages
items.text: The list of review pages has a search on the server and pages of 10, 20 or 50; a review page appears without a deployment and stays static.
items.acceptance: /<language>/reviews lists the pages and the search narrows the list.
